repair_available.note: _note_text is the shipped rule for shortening a finding. Applied to the text already stored, it ends on a whole sentence where one exists inside the limit, and otherwise returns an explicitly labelled extract rather than a silent mid-sentence fragment. It never supplies a word the repository does not already hold, so it can repair how a truncation reads but not the missing evidence.

rule: A note is complete only if its last character can end a sentence. Text is recovered only from a longer complete string the repository already holds. No note is completed by appending punctuation, filler or generated text; what cannot be recovered is named and left alone.
